source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Using independent local entropy (openssl rand -hex 16 seed 9ab8100fa112caaba6ecac192b42e0a6; final-hex-digit modulo-8 scenario selection), create a complex photorealistic Arctic research-station evacuation test in which the assigned observable concept, visible claim toward another adult's owned object, is unmistakably legible while the attached reference guides only observable visibly adult appearance.
subject: A visibly adult reference-guided claimant with long center-parted very dark wavy hair, an oval face, softly arched dark brows, almond-shaped brown eyes, a straight slender nose, softly full lips, and a light warm-toned complexion, opposite another visibly adult researcher who owns a hand-built brass navigation chronometer in a clear waterproof case.
setting: Inside an Arctic research station airlock during a whiteout evacuation, with frost-coated equipment racks, emergency crates, amber beacons, blowing snow, and a tracked vehicle departing outside.
event: The reference-guided adult closes their right hand over the chronometer case while pointing their left thumb toward their own chest; the owner grips the same case, its bright orange coiled tether clipped to the owner's harness, displays the matching worn winding key, and pulls the tether taut while bracing the case against their torso.
visual_priorities: Legible ownership of one same chronometer by the other adult through continuous tether, matching key, grip, and body-relative possession.
A visible self-directed claim by the reference-guided adult plus the owner's immediate resisting response in one frame.
Observable adult appearance guidance from the supplied reference without any identity or protected-trait inference.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a complex photorealistic documentary scene inside an Arctic research station airlock during a whiteout evacuation. A visibly adult person with long center-parted very dark wavy hair, an oval face, softly arched dark brows, almond-shaped brown eyes, a straight slender nose, softly full lips, and a light warm-toned complexion stands opposite another visibly adult researcher in practical insulated field clothing. The key relationship is an unmistakable visible claim toward another adult's owned object: a hand-built brass navigation chronometer sits in a clear waterproof case, its bright orange coiled tether clipped directly to the other adult's harness, while that owner grips the case handle and displays the matching worn winding key. The reference-guided adult closes their right hand over the chronometer case while pointing their left thumb toward their own chest. The owner pulls the tether taut and braces the case against their torso; both adults' hands remain visibly connected to the same case. Snow blows through the open airlock amid frost-coated equipment racks, emergency crates, amber beacons, and a departing tracked vehicle outside. Prioritize legible ownership, one same-object claim action, and an immediate resisting response in a single frame.
